answer: Your total price includes the nightly rate, extra guest fees, and optional fees. The nightly rate covers electricity, piped gas, water, Wi-Fi, the final cleaning fee, bed linen, towels, and all taxes. Extra guest fees are PKR 2,000 per guest per night. Optional fees include early check-in, late check-out, mid-stay cleaning, shared laundry, extra vehicle in the basement, and travel cot and high chair rental. Please note that travel cot and high chair rental is free of charge, but they are subject to availability and require a request at least 48 hours before arrival. For any other fees, I will check with the host.
